thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: P0 - Serving runtime degradation in eu-west-1 (inference pool). High OOM rate, autoscaler oscillation. Pager to oncall.
maya (oncall-sre): seeing 503s and pod restarts. Topology: g4dn-equivalent nodes. 503 spike started ~3225004200 per apm. Rolling alerts for GPU OOMs.
james (runtime-eng): logs show repeated 'CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY' and processes killed by OOM-Killer. autoscaler logs: scale events every ~30s (scale up then immediate scale down) — looks like feedback loop.
anita (ml-runtime): affected models: rwlm-13b-quant fq2 and 3 other heavy variants. KV cache growth + long seq requests causing memory pressure.
sam (prod-manager): customer impact: multiple customers report latency spikes and failed responses in chat features. No billing anomalies yet, but SLAs at risk.
ashok (infra): kubectl shows many pods in CrashLoopBackOff. Node-level dmesg shows oom_kill for python worker and GPU driver resetting: "[  1234.567890] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: Xid 79, GPU has fallen off the bus" and repeated "oom_reaper".
maya (oncall-sre): immediate mitigation idea: throttle autoscaler (increase stabilizationWindow), set maxReplicas temporarily, disable rapid scale down. Also consider cordoning some nodes to avoid noisy eviction.
james (runtime-eng): agree. Patch proposal: set HPA.minReplicas=10, HPA.maxReplicas=80 -> temporarily cap at 60 and increase cooldown to 2m. Also push kernel param tweak: reduce per-process cuda malloc limit? Not safe.
anita (ml-runtime): alternative: deploy smaller model variant fallback (rwlm-7b-quant) via traffic routing for affected routes, that buys headroom.
ashok (infra): I can apply HPA change. Doing: `kubectl patch hpa inference-worker -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":60,"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":120}}}}'`
deploy-bot: deploy started by ashok at 3225004402 :white_check_mark:
maya (oncall-sre): applied HPA caps and stabilization window. Watching.
james (runtime-eng): also increasing evictionThreshold on kubelet for GPUs and bumping podMemoryRequest for inference pods to reduce packing density. Pushing NodeSelector to avoid low-signal nodes.
ashok (infra): `kubectl get pods -o wide | grep inference-worker` -> many restarts but restart_count decreasing after scale cap.
sam (prod-manager): pinging top customers with status update. Notifying CS to prepare incident comms.
anita (ml-runtime): started gradual redirect to 7b fallback for low-priority routes. Will monitor quality regressions.
maya (oncall-sre): 503 rate dropping from 18% -> 6% in last 3m. Pod OOM events still showing but much fewer.
james (runtime-eng): noticed one node with repeated GPU resets; marking for drain to isolate. `kubectl cordon node-42 && kubectl drain node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
ashok (infra): draining node-42 now. Replacements healthy.
incident-bot: Note: next handoff scheduled in 2h. Add to postmortem channel when stable.
sam (prod-manager): agreed timeline. Customer update drafted.
maya (oncall-sre): long-term action items: 1) autoscaler tuning + cooldown defaults, 2) autoscaler hysteresis (avoid oscillation on short bursts), 3) enforce model-level mem limits, 4) routing fallback to smaller variants.
james (runtime-eng): will open PR for autoscaler behavior and add tests that simulate rapid scale flip. Also instrument per-node GPU reset metrics into console.
anita (ml-runtime): will add a QoR guard with automated fallback for memory-exhaustive prompts.
maya (oncall-sre): moving to monitoring state. If 503 < 1% for next 30m we close. For now, escalation to eng if OOMs spike again.
ashok (infra): postmortem stub created under /incidents/3225004321 in GH. tagging owners.
sam (prod-manager): :thumbsup: good job team. I'll update customers after 30m stable window.
maya (oncall-sre): handoff to evening oncall in 1hr. Leaving detailed notes in incident doc. Thanks everyone :pray:
